title: Contains Duplicate
description:
# Contains Duplicate

Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears **at least twice** in the array, and return `false` if every element is distinct.

## Example 1:

**Input:** nums = [1,2,3,1]
**Output:** true

## Example 2:

**Input:** nums = [1,2,3,4]
**Output:** false

## Example 3:

**Input:** nums = [1,1,1,3,3,4,3,2,4,2]
**Output:** true

## Constraints:

*   `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
*   `-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9`

solutions.name: HashSet - One Pass
solutions.description:
## Approach

Use a HashSet to track elements we've seen. For each element, check if it already exists in the set. If yes, we found a duplicate.

## Complexity Analysis
- Time Complexity: O(n) - Single pass through the array
- Space Complexity: O(n) - HashSet stores up to n elements

solutions.name: Sorting
solutions.description:
## Approach

Sort the array first, then check adjacent elements. Duplicates will be next to each other after sorting.

## Complexity Analysis
- Time Complexity: O(n log n) - Due to sorting
- Space Complexity: O(1) or O(n) - Depends on sorting algorithm

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.description:
## Approach

Compare every pair of elements to check for duplicates.

## Complexity Analysis
- Time Complexity: O(n²) - Nested loops
- Space Complexity: O(1) - No extra space
